WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, f.store_key, f.etl_loaded_at, cs.format
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
)
SELECT format, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_line_ids,
  count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_receipt_lines,
  count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts, sum(net_amount) AS net,
  round(sum(net_amount)/count(DISTINCT receipt_id),2) AS atv,
  min(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load
FROM base GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, sum(f.net_amount) AS net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
  GROUP BY 1,2
), ctl AS (
  SELECT store_id, business_date AS sale_date, receipts, net_sales_before_returns AS net
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id < 900
)
SELECT count(*) AS store_days, sum(CASE WHEN m.store_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS only_ctl,
  sum(CASE WHEN c.store_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS only_mine,
  sum(CASE WHEN m.receipts <> c.receipts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS receipt_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(m.net - c.net) > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS net_mismatch,
  sum(m.receipts) AS my_receipts, sum(c.receipts) AS ctl_receipts, sum(m.net) AS my_net, sum(c.net) AS ctl_net
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON m.store_id = c.store_id AND m.sale_date = c.sale_date
